titulo.alumno: B2 opinion: free access to museums

intro: Distinguish the socio-cultural arguments for universal free museum access from the financial sustainability arguments put forward by heritage managers.

palabras.consejo: A commercial system of ticket-based revenue collection.
A plural adjective for considerable costs.
The spatial and technical arrangement of an exhibition.

texto: Rendere interamente gratuiti i musei civici ogni giorno della settimana amplierebbe senza dubbio l'accesso alla cultura, soprattutto a beneficio di studenti, ricercatori e famiglie a basso reddito che vedono nel costo del biglietto un ostacolo concreto. L'esperienza di altre capitali europee dimostra che l'ingresso libero moltiplica i visitatori e stimola l'economia di quartiere, favorendo librerie, caffè e botteghe artigiane. D'altra parte, però, i direttori museali ricordano che gli introiti derivanti dalla bigliettazione risultano tuttora indispensabili per coprire le ingenti spese di custodia, illuminazione, restauro scientifico delle opere e allestimento di mostre temporanee. Un compromesso realistico ed equilibrato potrebbe consistere nel mantenere gratuito l'accesso permanente alle collezioni stabili per i residenti del territorio, continuando invece ad applicare una tariffa ragionevole ai turisti e per i grandi eventi espositivi di richiamo internazionale.

frases.estudio: Rendere gratuiti i musei favorisce l'accesso alla cultura e sostiene l'economia locale.
frases.alumno: Making museums free favours access to culture and supports the local economy.

frases.estudio: Molte famiglie a basso reddito considerano il prezzo del biglietto un ostacolo importante.
frases.alumno: Many low-income families consider the price of the ticket a major obstacle.

frases.estudio: Gli introiti dei biglietti servono per finanziare la manutenzione e le mostre temporanee.
frases.alumno: Ticket income serves to finance maintenance and temporary exhibitions.

frases.estudio: Un compromesso ragionevole prevede la gratuità per i residenti e tariffe per i turisti.
frases.alumno: A reasonable compromise provides free entry for residents and fees for tourists.

piezas.titulo: Vocabulary: cultural policy and museum management

pregunta.texto: What main benefit do supporters of opening public museums without an entrance fee put forward?

opciones.texto: Democratising access to artistic heritage by removing the economic barrier for low incomes
opciones.explicacion: The article highlights the inclusion of students and modest families.

opciones.texto: Sharply increasing municipal tax revenue from parking fines
opciones.explicacion: It has no link with mobility or traffic penalties.

opciones.texto: Dismissing the curators and official guides to replace them with automatic kiosks
opciones.explicacion: It does not promote job cuts but greater public outreach.

frase.texto: Gli introiti della bigliettazione servono a finanziare la ___ delle collezioni d'arte.

opciones.explicacion: Preventive conservation work and ongoing technical repairs.
A contractual termination out of context in art management.
A generic term describing the cost, not the financing technical action.

pregunta.texto: What unavoidable difficulty do museum directors point out regarding indiscriminate free entry?

opciones.texto: The lack of sufficient funds to meet security, restoration and quality exhibition costs
opciones.explicacion: Ticket takings cover unavoidable operating expenses.

opciones.texto: Artists' flat refusal to have their paintings viewed by the general public
opciones.explicacion: Creators aspire to the widest possible dissemination of their works.

opciones.texto: The absence of natural light in all permanent exhibition rooms across Europe
opciones.explicacion: A ridiculous interpretation lacking expert rigour.

pregunta.texto: What conciliatory formula does the article propose to reconcile citizens' access with economic viability?

opciones.texto: Guaranteeing free access to permanent collections for residents while charging tourists
opciones.explicacion: A compromise between local residents' rights and outside income.

opciones.texto: Closing the museums five days a week and auctioning the artworks to the highest bidder
opciones.explicacion: It would destroy the common heritage instead of managing it in balance.

opciones.texto: Banning entry to any foreign visitor who lacks a diplomatic passport
opciones.explicacion: Discriminatory xenophobia opposed to the cultural vocation of the museum.

frase.texto: L'ingresso libero favorisce l'accesso alla cultura

piezas.traduccion: Free entry favours access to culture
piezas.explicacion: Put the arguments in favour of free entry in order.

pregunta.texto: What positive side effect does free entry have on the museum's commercial surroundings?

opciones.texto: It stimulates local trade, boosting bookshops, cafés and small craft workshops.
opciones.explicacion: Capitals with free museums see a rise in local trade.

opciones.texto: It causes the immediate collapse of all hotels and restaurants in the historic district.
opciones.explicacion: On the contrary, the flow of passers-by directly benefits the hospitality sector.

opciones.texto: It forces neighbourhood residents to move to residential estates on the outskirts.
opciones.explicacion: It does not produce a neighbourhood exodus but active community life.
